levels.surface: أحمد بن سلمة بن عبد الله النيسابوري
مبشر بن عبد الله بن رزين

notes: «12-25» is a number, left out. Jabir heard the first saying himself. Inside his account the father (unnamed, «أبي») says «قال: كلهم من قريش»; that relay is in the scene, so the father is not added (rule 6). Whether he is a link is not settled.
